name: metis
description: An open agent-skill ecosystem built on the USER.md convention. Skills serve the user.

scripts.pretest: npm run profiles:bundle && npm run skills:bundle
scripts.check: npm test && npm run profiles:check && npm run skills:bundle:check && npm run skills:check && npm run docs:build
scripts.table-chart:check: uv run --with 'matplotlib>=3.7,<4' --with 'PyYAML>=6,<7' python -B -m unittest discover -s skills/table-chart/tests -p 'test_*.py'
